summary: Round-2 regression of the 9 fixes from iteration_1. Backend: full pytest suite now 73/73 passing (66 pre-existing + 7 new round-2 cases in /app/backend/tests/test_round2_fixes.py). Verified via API: half-up money rounding in WhatsApp/message builders (13912.5 -> Rs.13,913), over-payment guard returns 400 'Amount exceeds outstanding balance of ...', DELETE /api/itineraries/{id} cascades bookings+invoices and returns cascade_deleted (orphans confirmed gone from GET /api/bookings and /api/invoices), brute-force lockout now keyed on X-Forwarded-For (429 on the 5th wrong attempt from one XFF), vendor_request email to seeded delivered+<label>@resend.dev now returns 200. Frontend (Playwright, 1920x1080, public preview URL): /bookings fresh load auto-selects the first booking (booking-detail visible, booking-empty count 0); vendor-share -> Email tab -> Send now shows 'Sending…'/disabled state, a success toast 'Email sent to delivered+veh-himalayan@resend.dev' and closes the modal (previously a fully silent 502); both WhatsApp CTAs are real <a target=_blank> anchors with https://wa.me/... hrefs (lead-whatsapp-btn and share-wa-open-btn); invoices record-payment dialog prefills payment-amount-input with the next unpaid split (9738.75 for Balance 70%) and an over-payment surfaces the backend 400 as a visible toast. All 9 requested items PASS. All TEST_ data was purged afterwards (itineraries/bookings/invoices back to 0, login_attempts cleared, 2 seeded leads intact).

minor.issue: The over-payment guard uses `if data.amount > outstanding + 0.01`, so a payment can overshoot the total by up to 1 paisa (reproduced: total 13912.50 -> paid 13912.51, status 'paid'). Cosmetic but it lets stored `paid` exceed `total`; clamp the recorded amount to min(amount, outstanding) instead of the raw epsilon allowance.

Balance split due_date = booking.start_date - 7 days with no lower bound, so for a near/past departure the balance instalment is due BEFORE the advance and in the past (observed: Advance due 2026-08-29, Balance due 2026-08-03 for a 10-Aug-2026 departure). Clamp with max(today, start_date - 7d).

Not a defect, but noted: the managed Resend proxy rate-limits real sends ('429 email rate limit exceeded'). Running the pytest suite twice back-to-back makes the 3 real-send tests fail with 429. Recommend marking those tests as skip/xfail on 429 (or gating them behind an env flag) so the suite stays deterministic.
No /api/health endpoint exists (returns 404); only GET /api/ responds. Minor - add a health route for readiness probes.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate data-testid="share-email-error" is rendered twice (preview.error at line 121 and emailErr at line 133). Strict-mode locators resolve to 2 nodes; make them distinct (e.g. share-email-preview-error vs share-email-send-error).

integration_issues.issue: Inconsistent with the /bookings fix: Invoices still shows 'Select an invoice to view payment schedule.' on a fresh load / deep link (invoice-detail count 0) and requires a click. Apply the same auto-select-first behaviour.

issues: No new contrast/spacing/alignment defects. Still open from iteration_1: native <input type=date> instead of the shadcn Calendar on itin-start-input / lead-start-input / lead-end-input.

LOW: clamp the Balance split due_date to max(today, start_date - 7d) - it can currently be earlier than the Advance due date / in the past.
LOW: auto-select the first invoice on /invoices fresh load (mirror the Bookings fix).
LOW: de-duplicate the two data-testid="share-email-error" nodes in ShareModal.
LOW: make the 3 real-email pytest cases tolerate/skip the provider 429 rate limit so the suite is repeatable.
critical_code_review_comments: All 9 iteration_1 fixes are implemented correctly and verified end to end; no regressions found in the 66 pre-existing tests.
emailer.send_email now maps upstream 4xx to the same status with the provider reason (verified live: a 429 'email rate limit exceeded' propagated as 429 with the reason instead of a blanket 502).

auth.py rate-limit identifier now takes the leftmost X-Forwarded-For with a request.client.host fallback - lockout reproducibly triggers on the 5th wrong password. The attempt count still does not decay after the 15-minute window (only cleared on successful login) - unchanged from iteration_1, still worth fixing.

Playbook auth checks all pass: password hashes are $2b$12$, login sets HttpOnly+Secure access_token/refresh_token cookies, app-level CORS is an explicit allowlist (no ACAO for an unknown Origin on localhost:8001) with allow_credentials=true, seed_users is idempotent and re-hashes the admin password when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes. Note: the edge/ingress injects 'access-control-allow-origin: *' on the public URL - infra behaviour, not app code.
bookings/invoices still snapshot total/cost/profit/start_date from the itinerary with no recompute on itinerary edits (open from iteration_1).

backend_test.py does not clean up the itineraries/bookings/invoices it creates; each run leaves TEST_ artefacts that inflate dashboard KPIs. Add a class-scoped teardown that DELETEs the created itineraries (cascade now handles the children). I purged them manually this round.
